title: UI inventory of claude/redesign at job start
scope: Authored application app/web and its current definition-driven controls. No redesign proposals or app code changes.

conventions.ids: DOM ids use dom:; semantic ids distinguish dynamic/control-template surfaces.
conventions.file: Relative repository path and source line at source_commit.
conventions.frequency: Researcher guess, not measured usage: every session / often / sometimes / rare / setup once.
conventions.control_count: Distinct descendant button/menu/tab/setting families, recursively; excludes this node itself and shared-state nodes. Counts are inventory breadth, not simultaneous visibility. Repeated rows count once; disclosed panels and mutually exclusive states are included. Passive preserved-value rows are excluded from interactive counts.
conventions.shared_state: kind=setting with shared_state=true denotes state rather than an extra visible input.
conventions.visibility: who_sees includes role and conditional gates. A writable player invite can edit maps broadly; selected-player ownership is checked separately for some personal features.
conventions.phone: Up to 720 px; same tool/panel DOM is moved between tabs. Screenshot widths are 1440 and 390.
conventions.templates: Braces mark runtime labels; repeated record families describe arbitrary chunk/task/item/source/goal rows rather than enumerating personal data.
conventions.dialog: Most named dialog nodes are variants of one #tool-dialog, not stacked native dialogs.

observations.fact: Settings contains Map, Rolling, Tasks, Panels and Time estimates; only selected section is rendered except search. Mobile opens section list then detail; last section is browser-local.
Current scalar catalogue has no unassigned non-map-display legacy entries: Older settings is a conditional generation path but no current visible row.
Settings search checks labels, descriptions and internal IDs; saved monster names are searchable. Clear/Escape returns to selected section.
View-only hides Settings, Chunk Rules, Teleports, Feedback, backups/import, original sync and gameplay writes; Advanced resolves false. Search, History, About and News remain available.
Kept original rules have read-only rows only with Advanced; no input, More or reset button.
Unknown persisted personal rule keys are added to Additional and older rules dynamically.
Parent-disabled rule controls retain child choices; Rare Drop/Secondary Primary Amount and Inclusive editors, Kill X Amount and KeyItem Bosses under Rare Drop are exceptions.
All dialog content shares tool-dialog. Search uniquely uses dialog.show() and permits map interaction; remaining surfaces use showModal().
No README dialog is implemented by inspected authored UI modules; README is repository documentation.
Player invite can edit both maps. Linked member limits restore scope; administrator chooses whole save or one member.
Full backup replacement creates a new undo boundary; member-only restoration keeps shared rules and History and remains undoable.
OBS management is administrator only. Standalone overlay pages contain no interactive controls; secret remains in fragment and in memory.
Pending unmapped routes have no availability override. Unusable members-only routes are folded but retain ordinary route controls inside their disclosure.
Automatic availability and custom teleport operations are pinned to selected member/revision; changing save or member prevents stale writes.
Feedback opening acknowledges displayed received items; administrator has unread badge and all-item handling controls, player only sees own items. Context requires Advanced and Stream-safe off.
Original source sync automatically fetches preview on opening; Rules and Tasks are unchecked by default. Chunk candidates/pending moves may require related groups selected together.
Invite/overlay creation secrets cannot be recovered from saved row listing. Closing, cancelling or creating another clears secret; revocation is irreversible and uses in-dialog confirmation.
News opening updates browser-local changelog seen marker; roadmap refetches on every open and shows only statuses with items.
Map display is linked from More and Settings Map; Chunk Rules is linked from Info and Settings Rolling; History also opens from Rules Profiles & history. These handoffs reuse current surfaces.
Chunk Rules replaces its normal modal contents with temporary sandbox rules while sandbox is active.
Teleports and Feedback use sections and chip filters, without tab navigation; Settings alone uses section navigation and mobile tap-in list.
Helper has five navigation buttons and own player selector; hides map workspace while open.
Advanced detail in Helper requires canWrite and advanced preference; viewer does not get advanced estimate details.
Mining/Woodcutting/Banking preference sections require canWrite and matching gathering skill; these save personal preferences.
Starting-level override appears only with a valid observation; missing observations require a temporary starting level.
Chunk drop catalogue is F2P-only; manual rate remains usable under members rules.
Profile player chooser changes displayed profile without changing the map.
Profile Current BiS navigation is explicitly read-only even for an admin session.
Activity training plan is absent for viewers, while Helper temporary calculation inputs remain available.
Activity route cards are Fastest, Balanced and Makes money; Helper focuses on fastest F2P Ironman training.
RuneMetrics section is below Activity Info tabs, collapsed by default, and absent for viewers.
Viewer links hide Sync levels, rolling, sandbox and random-start controls but retain informational surfaces.
XP choices permits editing only when writable, outside Sandbox, and admin or matching sessionMember; unavailable-mode rewards show text.
Members start requires exactly two players and writable role; preview includes both maps.
Members reset requires typed members, matching save revision, and successful command; Before going members backup saved first.
Show on map closes the tool dialog before highlighting; unlocked legend counts either player.
Area Player selector exists only when Group view is checked; As members is read-only analysis.
Choose a random starting chunk sends a command directly; no separate random-start dialog exists.
Rolling disabled if cannot write, Sandbox active, roll busy, no owner or pending choices; pool size further gates Pick and Roll 2.
New chunk tasks popup shows at most 100 task buttons, with sidebar reminder when more.
Journal uses shared conflict-aware note editor and retains drafts; partner journals read-only.
canWriteMember excludes Sandbox and another player under member-bound session; members start callback uses canWrite outside Sandbox.
All time and Last 30 days range buttons only appear when dated history spans more than 30 days.
Pending roll acceptance actions immediately send commands; no dedicated pending confirmation. View remains available to viewers.
Finish-line shared draft editing is writable; custom completion tick restricted to admin or matching player.
Ask your partner is a read-only projection of supplies from partner chunks for unfinished own tasks, with no messaging or gathering command.
Death estimate appears in locked surface chunk Preview outside Sandbox; calculations are advisory and do not alter roll eligibility.
Death panel displays unknown estimates expanded by default; Advanced reveals calculation diagnostics.

canWrite checks sessionReadOnly only; member-scoped ownership gates appear explicitly on BiS hand records, XP choices and finish-line custom ticks, while normal selected-player controls use the common command permissions.
canWrite is !sessionReadOnly; no extra admin-only gate on these controls.
Assigned invite claims bind sessionMember even on partner map; admin claims bind selected player. Stale/Sandbox/inspection-only/unassigned custom claims disabled.
Tasks/Clues tabs require canWrite. Preview also requires surface not owned by selected player. Contents/Note/Inside/Access can appear for viewers with readable data.
Pending-roll chunks offer no ordinary status actions. Owned Unlock removal uses native confirm. Sandbox replaces actions with draft toggle.
Goal writer is canWrite && !sandbox.active; goals remain shared and independent of map player task lists.
Ledger Both means full union; sidebar Both means tasks with both owners. Review player does not change map. Dates local/inclusive; undated completions appear only All time.
Restore actions skip confirmation for at most ten tasks and use inline Restore/Cancel above ten. Group restoration repeats per owner.
Colours require write/surface/!sandbox; four named slots per owner. Group-view summary shows annotations of both players.
Quick Sticker entry requires canWrite and surface with no !sandbox guard in screen-chunks; do not infer whether persistent Sandbox sticker commands succeed from entry point alone.
Task detail retains explicit review member/revision and suppresses stale detail hydration; note conflict preserves draft and offers remote/draft choices.
Phone shares sidebar DOM; phone Tasks tab determines visibility. Task hover uses touch hold; chunk context uses long press.
Group backlog Restore listed ignores text search, but respects current owner scope; reason restore acts on searched reason-group rows.
Goal task links are interactive only when writable outside Sandbox and task resolves. Item links remain saved labels; viewer/Sandbox links are noninteractive labels.
Phone layout breakpoint is max-width 720px. Same dock/aside controls move into phone views.
Map tooltip renders membership only with membership overlay; IDs only when advanced preference. It includes visible owner colours/annotations and connected partner routes in Group view.
